basis: Direct user reply to the displayed inclined-water-surface versus separate-splash question.

interpretation.certainty: Qualitative user interpretation; preserves the wording closer to rather than asserting exact ground truth.
interpretation.control_purpose: Protect the displayed inclined/deforming water-surface feature; do not use it as a confirmed splash-only negative.
interpretation.scope: Display-only rectangle X[800,1110), Y[400,650); no traced contour, pixel truth or production mask.
interpretation.adjacent_frames: Display context only; no separate contour identity or correspondence certified for every frame.

supersedes: Pending human question for s5-inclined only. The frozen scene inventory, preflight and display receipt remain byte-identical.
limits: No exact contour, scalar Y, target candidate, per-pixel mask or temporal correspondence label.
No maximum slope, speed cutoff, horizontal flattening or automatic boundary-selection rule.
No general claim that all splashes, streams or water-video contours are reportable surfaces.
No truth transfer to beer, milk, sample4, Oil/Foam outputs or Windows data.
Joint correspondence still requires independent material-side evidence; spatial coherence and motion alone do not establish physical identity.
